scenarios.description: All declared validation commands exit 0 and the gate may advance automatically. Evidence is machine-collected (command exit codes + trace), with no manual sign-off required.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Registry validator and promotion tests both exit 0; gate verdict is PASS with the evidence trail referencing the originating specification; no manual evidence is required when all automatic commands are green.

scenarios.description: A candidate trial that passes command-only validation but lacks a candidate_id / fresh agent_run_id must NOT be promotion-eligible. The gate must yield CONCERNS or FAIL rather than advancing, because command-only evidence is insufficient for promotion.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Candidate-aware held-out contract tests confirm that an empty candidate_id or agent_run_id yields promotion_eligible=False; the held-out suite validator exits 0; the gate records CONCERNS or FAIL when manual/fresh-agent evidence is missing.
